coverage_note: Building permits issued by the City of Naperville — Naperville only. Naperville straddles DuPage and Will counties and the city publishes its permit register as one; totals here are City of Naperville totals, labeled as such. Other DuPage County jurisdictions (Wheaton, Downers Grove, Elmhurst, and the county's own unincorporated permitting) publish their permits separately and are not in this feed. The city's register mixes every city department; this report counts only the building scope — the residential, commercial, sub-permit, sign, and elevator permit families — and only permits standing in a status that proves issuance (issued, complete, expired, temporary occupancy, or final inspection passed); applications still in review, awaiting fees, void, or cancelled are not counted. Department families outside the building scope (finance, public works, fire, truck route, right-of-way, special events, and the rest) are excluded and named on the Data Sources page. The feed publishes no contractor name, so none is shown. The city's data reaches us in batches: this pull carries permits issued through October 30, 2026, and the source layer was last updated November 10, 2026.

dedupe_rule.definition: One published permit = one PERMITNUMBER in the City of Naperville's Building_Permits_View layer. The layer's grain is one row per permit: no collapsing applies or is needed.
dedupe_rule.measurement: Scoped trailing-12-month window (ISSUEDATE >= 2025-11-24, ISSUEDATE <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, building PERMITTYPE scope — see pull_where_extra), measured 2026-11-24 against the live layer: 2,878 rows = 2,878 distinct PERMITNUMBER, 0 duplicates, before the status scope; 2,834 rows after the status scope. The pipeline's in-batch duplicate gate and the (county_id, source_record_id) upsert key guard every future pull.

field_map.address: Composed from the city's address parts (STREETNUMBER + PREDIRECTION + STREETNAME + STREETTYPE, plus UNITORSUITE as a unit suffix when the city states one), title-cased from the city's all-caps printing. Blank where the city publishes no street address, never inferred.
field_map.application_date: APPLYDATE (epoch ms in the ArcGIS feed, converted to the civil date).
field_map.category: From PERMITTYPE first: RESIDENTIAL and RESIDENTIAL: OTHER IMPROVEMENTS publish Residential; COMMERCIAL publishes Commercial. For the remaining families (SUB-PERMIT, SIGN, ELEVATOR), the work class decides: a RESD-prefixed work class publishes Residential and a COMMERCIAL-prefixed work class publishes Commercial; work classes naming neither stay NULL, never inferred.
field_map.city: The issuing jurisdiction: Naperville. The city's CITY field reads NAPERVILLE on most rows, is null on some, and reads UNINCORPORATED/NAPERVILLE (plus one WOODRIDGE row) on a handful; every permit in this feed was issued by the City of Naperville, so city publishes as Naperville (the Austin/Seattle issuing-jurisdiction treatment). The row's own ZIP (POSTALCODE) is carried as published.
field_map.contractor_rule: NONE CARRIED: this layer publishes no contractor field and no person-name fields at all (verified against the full 22-field schema, 2026-11-24), so contractor_name stays NULL on every record, never inferred. A separate City of Naperville contractors service exists; joining it is out of scope for this launch.
field_map.issue_date: ISSUEDATE (epoch ms, converted). The window is defined on it, bounded at both ends: the trailing 12 months ending at pull time (ISSUEDATE <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP in pull_where_extra). No scoped-type rows carry an issue date in 2027 or later (measured 2026-11-24: 0).
field_map.permit_number: PERMITNUMBER — verified exactly unique in the scoped window (2,878 distinct = 2,878 rows before the status scope, 2026-11-24 audit).
field_map.permit_type_source: PERMITTYPE, the city's own permit family (in scope: RESIDENTIAL, RESIDENTIAL: OTHER IMPROVEMENTS, COMMERCIAL, SUB-PERMIT, SIGN, ELEVATOR), with PERMITWORKCLASS — the city's closed work-class vocabulary (27 classes in the scoped window, from SINGLE FAMILY HOME and TOWNHOUSE UNITS to DRIVEWAY/SIDEWALK/STOOP and COMMERCIAL ROOFING/RTU/EXTERIOR REPAIR) — carried in the pull for trade classification and category only.
field_map.project_description: DESCRIPTION, the city's own scope text (rich free text on the scoped window permits).
field_map.scope_filter: The view mixes all city departments (40,212 rows all-time). pull_where_extra keeps only the building scope: PERMITTYPE IN ('RESIDENTIAL','RESIDENTIAL: OTHER IMPROVEMENTS','COMMERCIAL','SUB-PERMIT','SIGN','ELEVATOR') — excluding the finance, accounts-payable, public-works, fire-department, truck-route, right-of-way, telecommunications, special-events, community-services, temporary-improvements, miscellaneous, and green-energy families — AND only statuses reachable after issuance: PERMITSTATUS IN ('ISSUED','COMPLETE','EXPIRED','TEMPORARY OCCUPANCY','FINAL INSPECTION PASSED'). On the trailing-12-month window the type scope alone leaves 2,878 rows; the status scope removes 44 more (FEES DUE 31, CANCELLED 6, VOID 4, IN REVIEW 2, FEES PAID 1), leaving 2,834 published permits. Each excluded family and status is named here and on the Data Sources page (the Alachua/San Antonio scope-filter treatment).
field_map.status: PERMITSTATUS, mapped through status_map; the verbatim source value is kept in status_source. Only post-issuance statuses enter the population at all (see scope_filter): ISSUED and TEMPORARY OCCUPANCY publish as issued; COMPLETE and FINAL INSPECTION PASSED as complete; EXPIRED as expired.
field_map.valuation: VALUES PUBLISH (validated on the full status-scoped window, 2026-11-24): PERMITVALUATION is stated on all 2,834 permits (0 null); 2,420 state more than $0, 414 state $0 exactly as the applicants reported, and only 2 state exactly $1 — no placeholder pattern. The status-scoped sum is $473,725,590.84 and the largest single permit ($23,000,000) is 4.9% of it — no project-value restatement dominates (the wider type-scoped set was measured as well: its sum is $553,025,240 and its largest permit is $70,400,000, 12.7% of that total; that permit does not stand in an issued-proven status, so it is outside the published population). SQUAREFEET is not published (it reads 0 on most rows). The DB sum is verified against the source-side sum on the identical where before pages ship.
